What a bite does

Paralysis can progress within hours, but because the bite is painless and often happens during sleep, treatment is frequently delayed - this is a major reason for its high fatality rate despite only moderate venom stats.

Antivenom source. India.

If you are bitten

Get to a hospital that holds antivenom. Keep still, remove rings and watches, and do not cut, suck or tie off the bite. Use the red “Bitten?” button at the top of any page.
